profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at Rotech Healthcare, Inc.
profile.summary: Senior Full Stack Developer with 8+ years of experience designing and building scalable applications using React, Java/Spring Boot and Oracle PL/SQL and Mule. Skilled in modernizing legacy systems, creating secure REST APIs, and deploying applications across Linux environments. Experienced in Agile delivery, automation using Selenium, and cloud integration with AWS S3. Known for collaborating closely with business stakeholders to deliver high-impact solutions across healthcare, finance, and logistics domains.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Hands-on experience working across front-end, back-end, and database technologies, delivering complex solutions to business requirements.
• Proficient in developing large-scale Single Page Applications (SPAs) using JavaScript frameworks such as React. Displaying and organizing thousands of records in a grid format.
• Developed and modified Java Spring Boot Maven applications using Spring Tool Suite (STS) to update backend endpoints for frontend integration.
• Utilized Postman and Swagger to test and validate API endpoints
• Used Oracle PL/SQL Developer to create tables, stored procedures, and packages.
• Connected to Linux servers using SuperPuTTY; used Vim editor for file creation and configuration updates.
• Worked directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements, plan designs, build applications, and execute deliverables.
• Created diagrams and wireframes using Microsoft Visio for project planning and documentation.
• Coordinated with the networking team to generate Certificate Signing Requests (CSRs) and private keys for public SSL certificates.
• Update user access for the application authorization on keycloak.
• Collaborated with the network team to configure load balancing across Linux servers, improving application uptime, performance and reliability.
• Automated Medicaid and Medicare pricing updates using Selenium Web Scraping.
• Implemented key pair authorization to enhance the security of Snowflake database.
• Pull and Push documents from AWS S3 buckets to display it in UI application.
• Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform
• Experience in ETL processes, including data extraction, transformation, and loading during business merger.  Thymeleaf/Apache PDFBOX for java template to convert JSON document to PDF.  Import SSL certificate file to java cacerts.
• Used Codex/Claude AI to identify code improvements, refactor React components, and enforce coding standards across the application.
positions.insights: Spring Boot, Oracle SQL Developer and +7 skills

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed Application using Agile Methodology, that included iterative application development, weekly Sprints, daily stand up meetings.
•	Involved in grooming the user story, clearing any doubts with Business Analysts and Product team, assigning a story points. 
•	Worked on transforming the legacy H2OA application to H2O Digital using Angular 10.
•	Working with API developers to request for the HTTP services like GET, POST, PUT and necessary Data needed for the Front End development. 
•	Collaborate on Figma design with other developers and Business Analysts to clarify the design process and understand the work flow. 
•	Used different NPM command to build and run the application on localhost.
•	Perform code review with colleagues on Pull Request and get approved before merging to main branch.
•	Collaborating with Designers to get the required logo. 
•	Collaborating with QA testers on any defect and working on them to fix it.
•	Cherry Pick the PR from one branch to another to deploy the code to running release branches and other branches.  
•	Created accessibility and ADA compliant user components.
•	 Used lint to catch some of the format related errors before merging the code. 
•	Write SQL queries to update the database table records for testing the UI application. 
•	Developed application and test on multiple browser and in various size windows for compatibility.
•	Perform Unit testing along with integration testing on application. Used browser Inspector to debug the application.
•	Used CI/CD pipeline to continuously work on it and delivery the solution.

positions.title: IT Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and enhanced components of the LBS module within an Automated Warehouse System to process customer messages, transform data, and populate the LBS database accurately and efficiently.
• Developed Application using Agile Methodology, that included iterative application development, weekly Sprints, daily stand up meetings.
• Involved in Requirements gathering and analyzing the requirements of the client and the flow of the application as well as the application Framework.
• Worked closely with Business Analysts in understanding the Business requirements and Gathered information for enhancing the use cases for different functionalities and designs.
• Worked on MSSQL database to write functions, procedures, select queries, finding bugs and adding features.
• Used Team Foundation Server (TFS) to check out the files, edit and check back in.
• Sharing files with clients and team on a SharePoint.
• Perform code review with colleagues on Pull Request and get approved before merging to main branch.
• Collaborating with QA testers on any defect and working on them.
• Involved in developing HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript for client side presentation and, data validation on the client side.
• Wrote Typescript that transpiled into JavaScript via the CLI powered by GULP.
• Used GIT for collaboration with the team members and Gulp as a task automation tools.
• Used JIRA tool for Issue/bug tracking, monitoring of work assignment.
• Used Jenkins to trigger the automated build process on the feature branch before merging to develop branch.
• Used Bitbucket to manage the code repositories for multiple projects including pull request, creating new branch from main branch. Performed unit testing along with integration testing Chrome Inspector to fix bugs and worked closely with QA.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Preparing and maintaining a product website for a client in India. 
•	Worked with client on understanding their requirement, providing a demo and design. 
•	Involved in the development and implementation of the widget-based application using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. 
•	Hosted website on a hosting site for better management and managing a domain through GoDaddy.
